plan.title: Masked Vendor Names in Master QCS

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ directly in Master QCS.
Enable vendor name masking for everyone in the company.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled as required by the case.
Verify the first vendor is displayed with a masked label.
Verify the second vendor is displayed with a masked label.
Verify the first vendor's real identity is not exposed.
Verify the second vendor's real identity is not exposed.
Verify the first masked vendor's bid price.
Verify the second masked vendor's bid price.
Verify the higher bid is ranked second.
Verify the lower bid is ranked first.
Verify each line amount and total equal rate multiplied by quantity.
